title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Every position in this record is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The live record for v005 starts 1 October 2026, and the live record for v006 starts 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise, and the average winner was roughly +19%.

## Open positions on paper
- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper.
- The record also notes a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since.

This section reports the engine state from the running record. All listed engine positions are paper. The NEAR entry is reported as open since 12 October 2026, while each engine line above shows 0 positions open on paper. Because every entry here is paper, these lines describe recorded signals rather than live exposure. A reader checking the running record would see the same open-position lines for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006.

## Closed trades so far
- htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 5, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade.
- ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

The closed-trade averages are net per trade. The ATOM trade is the most recent closed result shown in the record, with an exit at 1.703 and a net result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. htf-rsi-v007 shows an average null net per trade across 5 closed trades. The trend engines show negative average net results across 6 and 7 closed trades. These are recorded outcomes, not forecasts, and one trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Market filter and breakout distance
- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: TRXUSDT is 12.12% below its high.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: ATOMUSDT is 16.17% below its high.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: THETAUSDT is 18.02% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: JUPUSDT is 1.57% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: TRXUSDT is 12.12% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: ATOMUSDT is 16.17% below its high.

The filter lines report whether the Bitcoin market filter is on or off for each trend engine. The distance lines report how far each named symbol is below its high relative to its 20-day breakout. No position is open on paper for either trend engine, so these distances describe proximity only. The filter being off is reported as state, not as a reason to act. The same distances appear for TRXUSDT and ATOMUSDT across both trend engines, while THETAUSDT appears for v005 and JUPUSDT appears for v006.

## Record updates and where to check
- This live snapshot was read at 09:24:02.027.
- The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.
- The record updates continuously.

This article reports the live record as it stands. It makes no projection and draws no conclusion about future performance. Every figure above is paper-only. The record updates continuously, so the same check at another time can show different positions, closed trades, filter states, or distances. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.
